transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Good question! You can start doing light exercise like gardening after 1 week following your surgery. 

However, you should avoid strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel or drops for dry eyes before your surgery, it's safe to continue using them unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

Your medication should be stored as directed on the bottle - check whether it needs to go in the fridge or kept at room temperature.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Some light sensitivity is quite normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses, and it usually just feels like things are brighter than you're used to. We'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to check it further.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's quite common to have some blurriness in the first week after surgery, and this usually improves quickly over time.

However, I don't have your specific details, so I'm not sure exactly how long it's been since your operation. If your vision is still quite blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything's okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! Just to confirm - have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you again!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Take care, and best of luck with your recovery.

verdict.label: pass
